children.name: BioMedShed offer cost-effective solutions for electrochemical and microfluidic-based sensing. Please see below for more details.
1. Fully customisable 3D printed electrode connectors2. Custom flow cells3. Custom 3D print design & manufacture4. Cut to size medical grade adhesive5. Laser-ablated gold electrodes (coming soon)

Ensures good electrical connection from biosensor pads to potentiostat, with spring-loaded contacts that protect gold film on biosensor pads. The components are significantly cheaper than commercially available alternatives and adapt to planar electrode formats.No fully customisable component at this price point is available elsewhere on the market.
Damion CorriganAlexandra DobreaAlisdair GordonMelanie JimenezJessie HowellOscar Weipers

Custom 3D printed connectors — £24.99Custom design flow cell — £1.00Custom design flow cell (no assembly) — £1.00Custom 3D print design and manufacture — £1.00Custom biosensor manufacture — £1.00Custom laser ablated gold biosensor — £1.00

As a part of Strathclyde University, BioMed Shed aims to assist customers with their electrochemical and microfluidic-based sensing needs. We offer off-the-shelf components made in house, manufacturing of custom designed electrodes, fluidics and 3D printed accessories, as well as expertise for the design process. As our manufacturing is done in small batches, we are able to provide a cost-effective platform for rapid prototyping and an iterative design process.​​

Custom 3D printed electrode connectors.Custom design flow cells.Custom 3D print design and manufacture.Custom biosensor manufacture.Custom laser-ablated gold biosensors.Cut-to-size medical grade adhesive.Market application: Research and Development.Publications: Nature article and PBSRC article.For further information, contact the BioMedShed research team before purchase.
